title: Supply on Hand for a Vacation Supply (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Definition.** For a vacation supply under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the supply on hand for the vacation is anchored on the fill the member actually holds:

(a) when an approved paper claim for the drug has a date of service later than every paid network claim for the drug, the days not yet run out of that paper-claim fill are counted;

(b) when, with no such paper claim, the most recent paid network claim carries a reversal, nothing is counted, because that fill was never dispensed;

(c) otherwise the days not yet run out of the most recent paid network claim are counted.

The days not yet run out of a fill are its days supply less the calendar days from its date of service, as day zero, to today, never below zero. An approved paper claim counts as a fill on its date of service for the days supply recorded on it; among several approved paper claims for the drug, the one with the latest date of service is compared. An approved paper claim for a drug with no paid network claim at all also falls under (a).

## Cases (hypothetical; today is day 40)

1. Paid network claim of 30 days dated day 5; approved paper claim of 30 days dated day 25. The paper claim is later: 30 less 15 gives 15 days on hand.
2. Paid network claim of 30 days dated day 25 with a reversal on record; no approved paper claim. Nothing is counted: 0 days on hand.
3. Paid network claim of 30 days dated day 25 with a reversal; approved paper claim of 30 days dated day 30. The paper claim is later than every paid network claim: 30 less 10 gives 20.
4. Paid network claim of 30 days dated day 25, not reversed; approved paper claim dated day 20. The paper claim is not later: 30 less 15 gives 15 from the network claim.
